description: Not affiliated with the U.S. government, GSA, or SAM.gov. Not a U.S. government service. US Trade and Development Agency business opportunities, feasibility studies, pilot projects, and technical assistance in developing countries. USTDA grants go to foreign project sponsors, who select US firms to perform the work. Filter by keyword, country, or sector. Present as information only; verify every fact against the USTDA opportunity page before acting. Follow-ups within 30 minutes after a search ride free (up to 30 per search); otherwise one accepted call counts as one use, regardless of how many records are returned. Every record carries a direct source link (or source name and record ID) so you can verify and cite the underlying record.

remaining uses, and reset time. kind is 'pseudonymous' (subject hash or

the caller has crossed the threshold; absent otherwise.
